## What this is

The PCSS Alumni Digital Archive is an independent reconstruction of public material once hosted at pcssalumni.com. Its maintainable pages are written in Quarto Markdown (`.qmd`) and rendered to static HTML.

## What has been recovered

The original navigation, mission, yearbook catalogue, scholarship recipients and school history have been mapped. Recovered association records, school collections, event pages, course calendars and alumni stories are published directly on this site. A preservation set of 69 valid yearbook editions is available: 1930, every year from 1951 through 2017, and separate junior and senior books for 2002.

## How files are handled

Large yearbooks and raw preservation captures stay outside Git history. The recovered yearbook masters total more than 4 GB, so the published catalogue can point to durable external files while the maintainable site remains small enough for GitHub Pages.

## Accuracy, safety and privacy

Historical pages are identified as restored or summarized. Advertising code, trackers, obsolete forms, stale contact details and unverified private information are not republished.

## Relationship to the school

This project is not an official website of Port Credit Secondary School or the Peel District School Board.
